thread:
ana: FYI billing flagged a weird one from partner Northbridge — invoice NB-INV-2026-05-03 has PROMO-SYNC50 applied twice, looks like we over-credited them by $3,200. Need a debit memo and GL call.
billing-bot: Alert: invoice NB-INV-2026-05-03 triggered rule duplicate_promo_check v2 — identical promo_id found twice.
diego: can you paste the invoice export lines? want to confirm promo ids and amounts.
nana: oops typo, meant @ana.
nana: here's the CSV snippet:```
NB-INV-2026-05-03 | Northbridge | LineItem: DEDICATED-TPU | 3,200.00 | qty 1
NB-INV-2026-05-03 | Northbridge | Promo: PROMO-SYNC50 | -3,200.00 | promo_id:PROMO-SYNC50
NB-INV-2026-05-03 | Northbridge | Promo: PROMO-SYNC50 | -3,200.00 | promo_id:PROMO-SYNC50  <-- duplicate
Invoice balance: -3,200.00 (we owe customer)
```
priya: thanks. that is clearly duplicated. This should be handled as a promo reversal (contra-revenue) rather than a credit write-off.
tom-finance: GL recommendation: Debit 4-2109 (Promotional Contra) $3,200; Credit 1-1100 (Accounts Receivable) $3,200. Tag with partner code NB-042. Any objections?
diego: none from me. policy: partner approval required for any reversal where partner has redistributed invoice to end customers.
nana: got a note from Northbridge partner ops: "Confirmed — our billing pipeline accidentally re-sent promo rule PROMO-SYNC50 twice. We authorize the reversal and accept a debit memo." I'll attach their email.
priya: perfect. priya: finance pre-approval on record. I'll create debit memo template and route to Partnerships + Legal quick review.
tom-finance: who signs for <10k? Partnerships lead + partner ops. CFO only for >25k.
priya: yep. I'll include language: "Debit memo to reverse duplicate application of PROMO-SYNC50 on invoice NB-INV-2026-05-03. Amount: $3,200."
diego: please include the original invoice PDF and the partner ack in the journal entry for audit.
billing-bot: Action recorded: reversal_case RC-2026-442 created, amount 3200, status pending_memo.
nana: once I upload the signed memo i'll ping here.
tom-finance: journal posting instructions once memo attached: DEBIT 4-2109 Promo Contra $3,200 / CREDIT 1-1100 AR $3,200. Reference NB-INV-2026-05-03 and RC-2026-442.
priya: i'll prep the NetSuite reversal batch and set effective_date to invoice date to avoid gap in revenue recognition.
diego: quick check — will this affect MRR? shouldn't. it's a billing correction, not subscription change.
priya: confirmed, no MRR change. it'll post as contra revenue in the period of invoice.
nana: thanks all, i'll upload attachments and mark complete after signatures :thumbsup:
billing-bot: Note: customer notifications suppressed to avoid confusion; Partnerships to decide if partner-facing comms needed.
nana: closing once journal is posted.
